The command-line options of `StrataEditor` at engine `319075e3f92b` (`c_Arguments`, `StrataEditor/src/EditorApplication.cpp`).

| Option | Value | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | `<directory or .stproj>` | Open this project |
| `--commands` | `<script.json>` | Run a command script at startup (a JSON array of {command, parameters, expect, bind}) |
| `--quit-after-commands` |   | Close once the command script finished |
| `--frames` | `<count>` | Stop after this many frames |
| `--screenshot` | `<file.png>` | Save the last frame (with --frames or --quit-after-commands) |
| `--headless` |   | Run without a window (rendering stays available for captures) |
| `--no-gpu` |   | Run without a graphics device (implies --headless) |
| `--windowed` |   | Open a 1600x900 window instead of a maximized one |
| `--window-size` | `<width>x<height>` | Open a window of exactly this many pixels (at least 640x360) instead of a maximized one |
| `--ui-scale` | `<factor>` | Draw the UI at this scale instead of the display's (1 is 100%) |
| `--layout` | `<file.ini>` | Keep the panel layout in this file |
| `--no-automation` |   | Do not serve automation (StrataCLI, MCP) |
| `--automation-port` | `<port>` | Serve automation on this port (0, the default, picks a free one) |
| `--idle-timeout` | `<seconds>` | Close after this long without an automation client (0: never) |
| `--imgui-demo` |   | Offer ImGui's demo window in the Help menu |
| `--version` |   | Print the version and exit |
| `--help` |   | Print this help and exit |
